name: Skerry
description: A hard ruled lattice with the occasional rock breaking the surface inside it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @random(0.7) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; @size: @pick(38%, 58%); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg); transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
